captures.name: app-back.png
captures.review: Back returns the ordinary app host to the visible Start grid with phone navigation intact.

captures.name: app-home-restored.png
captures.review: Home activation restores the ordinary app Start grid and visible photo tile.

captures.name: app-start.png
captures.review: Ordinary app host shows the populated Start tile grid, status row and three phone navigation buttons within Android's visible system bars.

captures.name: app-wallet.png
captures.review: Wallet route shows selected all header, preview headers, search field, empty-wallet content and application-bar add/import/more controls within the native safe area.

captures.name: device-action-center-revoked.png
captures.review: After notification-listener revocation the shell fixture and private body disappear; pre-existing demo messaging/outlook rows remain.

captures.name: device-action-center.png
captures.review: Final Action Center capture visibly contains the complete FerroUI-bootstrap and Native-listener nonce labels inside the scrolling notification area.

captures.name: device-active-call.png
captures.review: Native call screen shows caller 5550102, active state, end-call/mute/audio/hold controls and numeric keypad. This capture does not establish successful interaction with those additional controls.

captures.name: device-ended-call.png
captures.review: Native call screen shows call ended and Return to phone. Android's privacy indicator is still visible in this captured frame; native telemetry separately confirms no remaining call or foreground call notification.

captures.name: device-messaging.png
captures.review: Messaging visibly renders sender 5550101 and the complete fixture body FerroUI SMS 6ab1dc01fb5cb2d7c6ba2ba1873332dd, wrapped inside the received message bubble.

captures.name: device-notifications-scroll-0.png
captures.review: Initial Action Center capture shows existing messaging/outlook rows; the shell fixture title/body are below the list viewport. This is an intermediate observation, not the final visibility proof.

captures.name: device-notifications-scroll-1.png
captures.review: First native list scroll reveals the fixture title and only part of its body; the retained subsequent visibility proof correctly waits for both complete labels.

captures.name: device-ringing.png
captures.review: Native PhoneCallActivity shows ringing state and its own answer/decline buttons. Android's incoming CallStyle heads-up notification overlays the upper caller area; the app's answer button remains visible and was the tapped target.

captures.name: device-start-unread.png
captures.review: Cold Start before Messaging is opened visibly shows exactly 1 on the canonical Messaging tile; separate native proof identifies the received emulator SMS.

captures.name: home-role-back-start.png
captures.review: Back after the HOME-role route sequence leaves the phone Start grid visible.

captures.name: home-role-returned.png
captures.review: Real Android Home input returns to the phone Start grid while the launcher role is selected.

captures.name: home-role-start.png
captures.review: After explicit HOME-role selection the phone Start grid remains mounted inside native system bars.

captures.name: home-role-wallet.png
captures.review: The HOME-role host's Wallet screen visibly renders the search field, empty state and application bar.

captures.name: launcher-back.png
captures.review: Back from Wallet returns launcher package's visible Start grid.

captures.name: launcher-home-restored.png
captures.review: Home activation restores the launcher package's Start content before role selection.

captures.name: launcher-start.png
captures.review: Launcher package launched without HOME ownership shows the Start grid in the ordinary app surface.

captures.name: launcher-wallet.png
captures.review: Launcher package's Wallet route renders header strip, content and application bar within Android insets.

history.qualification: Earlier active-call acceptance failure remains unresolved; later passes do not retroactively establish its cause.

limitations: Runtime evidence is from an API36 x86_64 software-GPU emulator, not physical ARM64/OEM hardware.
Incoming SMS/call and remote hangup were emulator fixtures; the app Answer button and real Android Telecom/service/notification state were observed.
The MMS codec exercise reports zero RF requests; no carrier delivery, RF behavior, outgoing paid call or real-world emergency-call behavior was validated.
Android HOME ownership is a launcher role and does not confer Android system-shell ownership.
Screenshots validate this implementation on the test device; they do not establish exact original Windows Phone visual parity.

publication_retention.qualification: Original ZIPs and full source manifests are indexed above. Selected unmodified originals are committed through this relative manifest; temporary local paths identify the verification workspace.
